prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right choice depends on what you need (services, budget, industry, company size, culture fit). I can help you find the best fit. To give a useful recommendation, tell me:

- What services do you need? (e.g., SEO, PPC, social media, branding, web design, B2B demand gen, content, PR)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- What industry are you in?
- Do you prefer a local agency (Baltimore/Annapolis/Washington suburbs) or is remote OK?
- Do you want a large established agency or a small boutique shop?

If you want to start evaluating agencies yourself, check these criteria:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, revenue)
- Client references and reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn)
- Industry experience and creative/technical expertise you need
- Reporting cadence and KPIs they track
- Team size and who will actually do the work
- Pricing model and contract terms

Places to look for vetted Maryland agencies:
- Clutch.co and UpCity (reviews and rankings)
- Google Maps / Google Business Profiles
- Baltimore Business Journal / Washington Business Journal lists
- LinkedIn company pages and employee profiles

If you want, I can:
- Shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs (with pros/cons and estimated pricing), or
- Draft an outreach/template email and a shortlist of questions to ask prospective agencies.

Which option do you want, and what are your answers to the questions above?
